svg.title: The Shared Breath
svg.desc: A breathing guide. A warm sphere of light swells for five seconds and settles for five; follow it and your breath slows to six a minute, the rhythm that steadies a heart. Around it a ring of small lights pulses with the same breath, one for each of us, the wave passing slowly round the world. The caption is the fact the circle is made of: every person on Earth is breathing right now.
